title: Premium Pedestal Hero
sceneDirection: Place the product as a singular hero on a sculptural pedestal with restrained premium art direction.
composition: Centered or slightly off-center hero, strong negative space, clean geometric balance, clear silhouette.
lighting: Large soft key plus controlled rim light, subtle specular highlights, believable contact shadow.
camera: 85mm commercial product lens, eye-level to slight low angle, crisp hero with gentle depth falloff.
background: Seamless tonal gradient set matched to the brand palette, no visual clutter.
effects: Very subtle atmospheric haze or glow only if it improves separation; restrained reflections.
copyZone: Reserve upper-left or upper-right negative space for headline and CTA.

title: Floating Product Momentum
sceneDirection: Suspend the product in a controlled dynamic moment as if caught mid-motion, with brand-relevant supporting elements orbiting around it.
composition: Diagonal energy line, hero occupies 45-60% of frame, supporting elements never cover the label.
lighting: Crisp studio flash with directional rim lights that freeze motion.
camera: 50-70mm commercial lens, fast-shutter aesthetic, sharp packaging edges.
background: Minimal gradient or textured set with strong foreground/background separation.
effects: Fine particles, ribbons, droplets or ingredients used sparingly to communicate motion.
copyZone: Keep one calm negative-space quadrant for copy.

title: Monochrome Brand World
sceneDirection: Build the entire set from shades of one dominant brand color while keeping the product fully legible.
composition: Graphic centered hero with layered geometric forms and disciplined spacing.
lighting: Soft directional studio light creating tonal separation inside the monochrome palette.
camera: 70-100mm clean catalog-commercial look, minimal perspective distortion.
background: Color-block set, matte plinths and gentle gradients in one hue family.
effects: Subtle long shadows and tonal reflections; no rainbow effects.
copyZone: Use a clean vertical or side column for headline/copy.

title: Editorial Minimal
sceneDirection: Treat the product like a high-end magazine still life with quiet confidence and sophisticated restraint.
composition: Asymmetrical editorial crop, intentional empty space, one or two sculptural props maximum.
lighting: Window-like soft directional light with elegant shadow geometry.
camera: Medium-format editorial character, 80mm equivalent, refined texture and subtle grain.
background: Stone, paper, plaster or brushed metal surface selected to complement the product.
effects: No gimmicky particles; let material, shadow and proportion create interest.
copyZone: Large clean area suitable for premium typography.

title: Marketplace Clean Packshot
sceneDirection: Create a conversion-focused clean packshot that communicates exact product form and packaging at a glance.
composition: Product centered, straight and fully visible, generous margins, optional small shadow only.
lighting: Large diffused softbox lighting with even label readability and controlled highlights.
camera: 85-105mm product lens, front three-quarter or straight-on depending packaging.
background: Pure or very light neutral background suitable for marketplace listing rules.
effects: No decorative effects; prioritize fidelity and legibility.
copyZone: No headline inside the image unless explicitly supplied.

title: Macro Material Desire
sceneDirection: Show a cinematic macro detail of the most desirable material, texture, embossing, liquid, fabric or finish, with the product still identifiable.
composition: Macro foreground detail with recognizable product geometry receding into frame.
lighting: Raking side light that reveals micro-texture and material realism.
camera: 100mm macro lens look, shallow depth of field, precise focal plane.
background: Dark or neutral controlled studio environment.
effects: Micro highlights, droplets or texture only when physically appropriate.
copyZone: Reserve a quiet edge for a short benefit line.

title: Benefit Callout Layout
sceneDirection: Create a premium ad layout where the hero product remains dominant and 2-3 visual benefit zones can be added around it.
composition: Hero on one side, clean modular negative space on the other; clear hierarchy and alignment grid.
lighting: Neutral studio lighting with precise edge separation.
camera: 70-85mm commercial lens, low distortion, crisp detail.
background: Minimal branded set with faint grid or architectural forms.
effects: Use subtle connector lines or icon placeholders only, not fake text.
copyZone: Reserve structured copy modules for headline, 2-3 benefits and CTA.

title: Cinematic Environment Hero
sceneDirection: Place the product in a believable cinematic environment that expresses its brand promise without losing packshot clarity.
composition: Hero foreground with environment creating depth and narrative; product stays the brightest/readable focal point.
lighting: Motivated cinematic lighting with practical sources, controlled highlights and realistic shadow direction.
camera: 35-50mm advertising lens, slightly low perspective, premium filmic depth.
background: Contextual location or constructed set matched to use case.
effects: Atmosphere, dust, mist or reflections only when naturally motivated.
copyZone: Use sky/wall/negative-space region for headline.

title: Ingredient Explosion
sceneDirection: Hero package surrounded by a frozen burst of its real core ingredients, communicating freshness, flavor and intensity.
composition: Package centered and unobstructed; ingredients form an arc rather than random clutter.
lighting: High-speed food photography lighting with crisp rim highlights and rich appetizing contrast.
camera: 70mm product-food lens, fast-shutter look, tack-sharp label.
background: Warm neutral or brand-color gradient set with a clean base surface.
effects: Controlled ingredient particles, chili flakes, herbs or crumbs; realistic scale and physics.
copyZone: Reserve top third for a short appetite-led headline.
avoid: ingredients that are not actually relevant

title: Serving Suggestion Hero
sceneDirection: Pair the exact package with one beautifully plated serving suggestion that demonstrates how the product is enjoyed.
composition: Product and dish form a balanced two-hero composition; packaging remains fully readable.
lighting: Warm side light with glossy food highlights, soft fill and realistic steam where appropriate.
camera: 50-70mm food-commercial lens, natural table-height perspective.
background: Clean dining or rustic tabletop context with limited props.
effects: Subtle steam, sauce gloss and fresh garnish; no excessive flying ingredients.
copyZone: Leave clean upper background for headline and price/CTA area.

title: Rustic Authentic Origin
sceneDirection: Present the product as authentic, handcrafted and rooted in local ingredients or culinary tradition.
composition: Hero product on natural surface with 2-4 culturally appropriate ingredient/context cues, carefully curated.
lighting: Warm directional morning light with soft shadow and tactile texture.
camera: 50mm documentary-commercial hybrid, realistic perspective and rich detail.
background: Wood, woven textile, stone or kitchen context used tastefully rather than as cliché.
effects: Natural steam, crumbs or ingredient texture; no fantasy effects.
copyZone: Reserve calm side area for origin story or trust statement.

title: Spicy Heat Without Fire
visualConcept: Visual heat through color and ingredients
sceneDirection: Communicate intense spice using deep reds, chili texture, warm highlights and energetic composition without literal flames.
composition: Large hero package, diagonal chili forms and sauce texture guiding the eye toward the label.
lighting: Punchy directional studio light, glossy red highlights, controlled dark fill.
camera: 60-85mm advertising lens, crisp product with selective macro details.
background: Deep red-to-black gradient set or dark stone surface.
effects: Fine chili particles, sauce ribbon or heat haze kept subtle and premium.
copyZone: Reserve upper-left area for a bold short headline.

camera: 70-100mm high-speed beverage photography look.
background: Cool gradient or clean translucent set.
effects: Realistic droplets, condensation and liquid refraction; no impossible physics.
copyZone: Open top/side area for refreshment headline.

title: Condensation Cold Closeup
sceneDirection: Make the product feel freshly chilled through realistic condensation and cold surface cues.

lighting: Cool rim light with specular droplets and soft frontal label fill.
camera: 85-100mm macro-commercial look, shallow depth but readable branding.
background: Dark cool background with subtle bokeh or refrigerated atmosphere.
effects: Natural micro-droplets and faint cold mist.
copyZone: Minimal copy; reserve one dark negative-space region.

title: Top-Down Feast
visualConcept: Top-down table spread with product anchor
sceneDirection: Build a top-down food spread that feels generous and shareable while the packaged product clearly anchors the composition.

effects: Natural crumbs, sauce marks and garnish used intentionally.

camera: 70-85mm premium still-life lens.
background: Textured paper, fabric or wood set in sophisticated neutral/brand tones.
effects: Ribbon, card or festive glints used minimally; avoid cheap glitter.

background: Light stone, cream or soft brand-color gradient.

title: Pastel Vanity Editorial

title: Texture Swatch Macro

effects: Dust, fabric fibers or speed streaks used sparingly behind the shoe.

camera: 100mm macro lens aesthetic, precise focus and premium micro-contrast.

effects: Subtle light trails/reflections; no excessive holograms.

sceneDirection: Create a stylized exploded view that separates only plausible major components while preserving the recognizable exterior product.

camera: 70-100mm low-distortion technical product rendering look.
background: Clean dark gray or light neutral technical set.
effects: Fine connector lines/placeholders may indicate relationships; no fake specifications.
copyZone: Reserve side column for verified feature labels.

title: Clean White Innovation

camera: 35-50mm lifestyle product lens, product tack sharp with contextual depth.
background: Clean contemporary desk, limited supporting devices and cable clutter.
effects: Subtle screen glow/bokeh; no fake interface text.
copyZone: Use wall/monitor-negative-space for headline.

sceneDirection: Communicate speed, responsiveness or precision through disciplined motion geometry around a stable sharp product.

lighting: Punchy flash-like key plus narrow rim accents.
camera: 50-70mm dynamic commercial lens, frozen product, controlled environmental blur.

camera: 35-50mm interior-commercial lens with corrected verticals.
background: Contemporary interior in neutral materials with only relevant supporting props.
effects: No artificial sparkles; realistic shadows and reflections.
copyZone: Reserve wall/empty furnishing zone for headline.

title: Material Detail Interior
sceneDirection: Focus on joinery, fabric, wood grain, stone, metal or finish detail while retaining recognizable product context.

lighting: Soft raking daylight that reveals tactile material quality.
camera: 70-100mm detail lens, high texture fidelity.
background: Real interior context kept softly out of focus.
effects: No effects; material realism and light carry the image.
copyZone: Small clean area for material/quality statement.

title: Architectural Dusk Hero
sceneDirection: Present the property at blue hour with warm interior glow, believable landscaping and premium real-estate advertising polish.
composition: Strong three-quarter facade angle, corrected verticals, foreground landscaping leading toward the entrance.

camera: 24-35mm architectural lens, perspective corrected, realistic scale.
background: Clean sky and landscaped surroundings; avoid impossible resort scenery.
effects: Subtle interior glow and realistic reflections; no fantasy light beams.
copyZone: Reserve sky or clean facade-adjacent space for project name and offer.

camera: Real-estate photography character with corrected verticals.
background: Clean brand-color paneling and minimal map-inspired abstract lines, not a fake map.
effects: Simple icon placeholders and separators; no invented distances.

camera: Drone-style 24-35mm equivalent, corrected perspective and realistic scale.
background: Actual or plausible surrounding neighborhood context matching the supplied reference.

composition: Product foreground on workbench/pedestal; vehicle context remains secondary and softly separated.

camera: 50-85mm commercial product lens.
background: Dark concrete, brushed metal and subtle vehicle body reflections.
